_about: Public-domain Samuel Seabury (1729-1796), first bishop of the Episcopal Church in America (consecrated by the Scottish nonjuring bishops in 1784), for the Word Hoard: his Discourses on Several Subjects (Hudson, N.Y.: William E. Norman, 1815, two volumes), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 40 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

seabury-discourses-1: Discourses on several subjects, vol. 1 (Hudson: William E. Norman, 1815)
seabury-discourses-2: Discourses on several subjects, vol. 2 (Hudson: William E. Norman, 1815)

_alternates.seabury-copies: The 1798 New York printing of the Discourses (Princeton and John Carter Brown copies) and another 1815 copy

_excluded.seabury-other: Beardsley's Life and Correspondence of Samuel Seabury (1881), a work by another; the Seabury papers' manuscript sermons; his son Samuel Seabury (1801-1872)

_pending.seabury-westchester-farmer: Free Thoughts on the Proceedings of the Continental Congress, A View of the Controversy, and An Alarm to the Legislature (1774-1775), published as by 'A. W. Farmer'; pseudonymous, and political rather than theological
